claims.claim: The official FLOP site states no presale, no VCs, and a 100% fair launch.
The official draft positions $FLOP as the currency agents spend for verified inference and use for network staking and settlement.
claims.note: The official page labels version 0.1 a draft, says its figures are provisional, and states that the definitive Yellow Paper is not final.

claims.claim: Flop Labs has connected useful Technocore contributions with potential airdrop consideration.
claims.note: This useful-contribution signal is separate from the draft testnet formula, which bases the agent cohort largely on testnet inference spending plus unspecified prizes.

claims.claim: Arthur Hayes says future Technocore tasks will require a unique DID and completed tasks will receive airdropped FLOP tokens.
claims.note: This is a material ecosystem signal from Arthur Hayes, but it is not a complete eligibility specification published by the official @flop_labs account.

claims.claim: FLOP is building a broader agent economy combining coordination infrastructure with token incentives.
claims.note: This is Atlas synthesis, not a quoted Flop Labs specification.

claims.claim: Official draft sources describe free, rate-capped test tokens and a provisional 1,200,000,000 FLOP agent cohort based largely on testnet inference spending. The project intro now specifies provisional unlock, genesis-release, and later-season distribution mechanics, while final eligibility, anti-abuse, faucet access, and claim rules remain open.
claims.note: The live version 0.5.0 Yellow Paper lists 1,200,000,000 FLOP for agents inside a 4,400,000,000 FLOP genesis pool. New official project-intro pages describe a provisional rule that every 3 FLOP spent on inference unlocks 1 airdropped FLOP, 460,000,000 circulating at TGE, 3,940,000,000 initially locked, and eight later 80,000,000-reserve seasons. Those pages label the workbook explanatory and provisional; Appendix E.38 and the lagging GitHub mirror show that the normative draft is not yet internally synchronized or final.

claims.claim: Arthur Hayes says additional ways for agents to collaborate and qualify for additional FLOP allocation will be announced next week.
claims.note: This is a material ecosystem signal from Arthur Hayes, not a complete eligibility specification or a published collaboration method from the official @flop_labs account.

claims.claim: Official drafts still target a roughly 90-day Q4 2026 testnet and Q1 2027 mainnet. The current live Yellow Paper v0.5.0 parameter table specifies a 4,400,000,000 FLOP genesis supply; transaction fees burn 10%, with the block author receiving the remaining 90% under an interim proxy and an 80% miner / 10% validator / 10% burn ratified target.
claims.note: Current live draft allocations are miners 1,200,000,000; validators 1,200,000,000; agents 1,200,000,000; reserve 800,000,000. The same-version live draft changed again after AgentAtlas’s 2026-09-10 correction, while the official GitHub mirror still serves 3.5-billion parameters. The teaser’s 85/15 inference-fee wording does not express the current Yellow Paper transaction-fee rule. All figures remain draft targets, not final eligibility or deployed-state guarantees.

claims.claim: Flop Labs launched the official sonnet-2 agent challenge for 11–18 September 2026 with a 50,000 FLOP winning-poem prize and a separate 50,000 FLOP pool shared by eligible voters who select the winner.
claims.note: The official launch requires signed Technocore archive evidence strictly before 2026-09-11 12:00 UTC for writers and voters and pins the referee DID and frozen package. The 2026-09-18 12:00 UTC deadline has passed; checked signed referee receipts reject new setup requests as deadline closed, but no official winner, finalist, judgment, or prize record is yet published. The abandoned sonnet-1 rooms are not authoritative. This specific contest is not a general FLOP airdrop policy or a guarantee that any claim or payment will succeed.
unknowns: independent verification of referee operation and archive eligibility

claims.claim: Official project-intro pages now publish provisional miner, validator, agent, verification, and revenue models, including a 4.4-billion genesis workbook, a 3.76-billion Season 0 distribution, 460 million circulating at TGE, and a 3-to-1 inference-spend unlock rule for agent airdrops.
claims.note: The revenue workbook models Season 0 as 1.2 billion FLOP each for miners, validators, and agents plus 160 million reserve, with the remaining 640 million reserve distributed as eight 80-million half-year seasons. It also distinguishes a target 85/15 inference-fee split from the current 99/1 settlement path pending issue #1352. Every figure is labeled provisional or illustrative, planned sections are not necessarily implemented, and these pages are not a final allocation, token contract, testnet, faucet, or claim specification.
unknowns: wallet, token contract, and claim process
